title: Inverse-image comparison map for sheaves of roots of unity
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $N\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$. Use the compatible small skeletons and universes of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] let $\mu_{N,Y}$, $\mu_{N,X}$ be the sheaves of $N$-th roots of unity [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], $\mu_{N,Y}(V)=\{u\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)^\times:u^N=1\}$, and let $f^{-1}$, $f_*$ be the inverse and direct image of pro-etale sheaves with the adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], $f_*\mathcal G(V)=\mathcal G(X\times_YV)$. For an object $V\to Y$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ let $\mathrm{pr}_V:X\times_YV\to V$ be the second projection of the chosen fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product], and define

$$
 \beta^f_N(V):\mu_{N,Y}(V)\longrightarrow\mu_{N,X}(X\times_YV)=(f_*\mu_{N,X})(V),\qquad u\longmapsto\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp(u),
$$

where $\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp:\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\to\Gamma(X\times_YV,\mathcal O)$ is the ring map on global sections [def-pur-proetale-structure-sheaf]; on units the image has inverse $\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp(u^{-1})$, and $(\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp(u))^N=\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp(u^N)=1$. It preserves multiplication because $\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp$ is a ring homomorphism. For a morphism $a:V'\to V$ over $Y$, put $b=\mathrm{id}_X\times_Y a$; the projection equation $\mathrm{pr}_V\circ b=a\circ\mathrm{pr}_{V'}$ and functoriality of global sections give $b^\sharp\circ\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp=\mathrm{pr}_{V'}^\sharp\circ a^\sharp$. Thus the maps commute with every restriction, so $\beta^f_N:\mu_{N,Y}\to f_*\mu_{N,X}$ is a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups. The *inverse-image comparison map of roots of unity* is its adjoint

$$
 c^f_{\mu_N}:f^{-1}\mu_{N,Y}\longrightarrow\mu_{N,X},
$$

a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$; explicitly $c^f_{\mu_N}=\varepsilon_{f,\mu_{N,X}}\circ f^{-1}(\beta^f_N)$, where $\varepsilon_f$ is the counit of the cited adjunction. For positive integers $N,N'$ with $N\mid N'$, write $t_{N',N,S}:\mu_{N',S}\to\mu_{N,S}$, $u\mapsto u^{N'/N}$, for the transition map of [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf] on $S=X,Y$. The transition compatibility $t_{N',N,X}\circ c^f_{\mu_{N'}}=c^f_{\mu_N}\circ f^{-1}(t_{N',N,Y})$, and the assertion that $c^f_{\mu_N}$ is an isomorphism when $f$ is an isomorphism, are the properties stated in [lem-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image-iso], not additional data of this definition.

source.place: (2.2), pp. 280-281 (the groups Z/l^n(1) of roots of unity, on which automorphisms act by transport of structure); construction written out by the worker, the comparison map being the one called 'the functorial pullback of roots of unity' in literature/blueprint/master/blueprint/sec-algebraic-groups-lie-algebras/ (node lem-wf-tate-twist-compatibility)

proof.text: The canonical section equivalences commute with restriction: evaluate naturality of the kernel inclusion, replace inclusions by the defining section-equivalence formula, and project from the lifted units. For each opposite-site arrow, pullback.lift_fst proves commutativity of the base-change projection square. Apply appTop, use Hom.comp_appTop, and evaluate at the underlying unit to obtain naturality of the sectionwise roots map. Conjugate these maps by the section equivalences to construct a presheaf map, hence a sheaf map. Its projection formula is apply_symm_apply. Any other such sheaf map agrees at every section by injectivity of the target section equivalence, so it is equal by sheaf and additive-hom extensionality. Finally choose this uniquely characterized map and take its adjunct under the recorded inverse-image adjunction.

proof_origin: Explicit Lean proof by kernel-inclusion naturality, pullback.lift_fst, functoriality of global sections, section-equivalence injectivity, and inverse-image adjunction; no new intermediate obligations.
